## What changed

**Two columns on the live screen ran together into one word.** A real machine,
mid-climb, showed `предзагрузка пакетовидёт` — "preloading packages" and
"running" with the space between them gone. The column width is measured from
the feed, the live line is not part of the feed, and `pad` returns a string
untouched when it is already wider than the column. A label longer than
anything scrolled past therefore lost its separator entirely.

The live line now counts toward the column width, so the column stops jumping
underneath it, and the padding helper guarantees a separator even when the
label overflows: a column may be narrower than its content, but two columns may
never touch. This is the screen a person watches for hours, and a defect there
is not cosmetic — it makes the tool look like it is malfunctioning at exactly
the moment they are deciding whether to trust it.
